id: Copilot sekarang memakai backend LLM sungguhan melalui Vercel AI Gateway, dengan context project, netlist, hasil simulator, history percakapan, dan katalog komponen terverifikasi.
Jawaban tidak lagi bergantung pada regex/fallback berulang sebagai jalur utama. Fallback lokal hanya dipakai jika LLM benar-benar gagal diakses.
Primary Simulator diubah menjadi Live Circuit: Run, Pause, Step Solve, Reset, live node probes, device voltage/current/power, dan fault injection.
Live Simulator memakai solver MNA project yang sebenarnya; perangkat yang belum punya model dideteksi sebagai unsupported dan tidak diberi hasil palsu.
Monte Carlo / thermal Reality Lab dipindahkan menjadi Advanced Field Analysis, bukan lagi simulator utama.
Engine berat tetap lazy-load supaya workflow utama lebih ringan untuk laptop spesifikasi rendah.
en: Copilot now uses a real LLM backend through Vercel AI Gateway with project context, netlist, simulator results, conversation history, and the verified component catalog.
Answers no longer rely on repeating regex/fallback logic as the primary path. Local fallback is only used when the LLM cannot be reached.
The primary Simulator is now Live Circuit: Run, Pause, Step Solve, Reset, live node probes, device voltage/current/power, and fault injection.
Live Simulator uses the actual project MNA solver; devices without supported models are explicitly flagged instead of receiving fabricated results.
Monte Carlo / thermal Reality Lab is moved to Advanced Field Analysis instead of being the primary simulator.
Heavy engines remain lazy-loaded so the main workflow stays usable on lower-spec laptops.

id: Copilot tidak lagi pura-pura sebagai LLM penuh: status UI menyatakan backend model belum aktif pada versi ini.
Tambah grounded reasoning untuk pertanyaan wiring/wayar berdasarkan netlist project aktif, termasuk arti pin dasar untuk source, resistor, diode, dan LED.
Tambah component-db.json sebagai katalog vendor terverifikasi dengan provenance URL dan tanggal verifikasi; part generik tidak diberi rating lapangan palsu.
Wire overlay tidak lagi memakai CONNECTIONS hardcoded. Garis schematic diturunkan dari netlist aktif yang terlihat di inspector.
en: Copilot stopped presenting itself as a full LLM before the model backend was connected.
Added grounded wiring reasoning from the active project netlist, including basic pin semantics for sources, resistors, diodes, and LEDs.
Added component-db.json as a vendor-verified catalog with provenance URLs and verification date; generic parts receive no fabricated field ratings.
Wire overlay no longer uses hardcoded CONNECTIONS and is derived from the active netlist.

title.id: Readable UI, Bahasa, dan Component Intelligence
title.en: Readable UI, Language, and Component Intelligence

id: Comfort UI menjadi default: teks, tombol, tab, inspector, library, simulator, dan chat diperbesar agar tidak membuat mata cepat lelah.
Tambah pilihan Bahasa Indonesia / English yang tersimpan di browser.
Tambah kontrol ukuran antarmuka dan kontras yang lebih nyaman.
Tambah Component Intelligence: status model, capability, limit, package/variant warning, dan confidence untuk komponen yang dipilih.
Tambah Patch Updates di dalam aplikasi agar setiap perkembangan terlihat jelas.
Sumber komponen spesifik mulai dikunci ke referensi vendor; entri generik tidak lagi dianggap mempunyai rating pasti tanpa MPN/datasheet.
en: Comfort UI is now the default: larger text, controls, tabs, inspector, simulator, and assistant chat.
Added persistent Indonesian / English language selection.
Added UI size controls and a more comfortable contrast profile.
Added Component Intelligence: model status, capabilities, limits, package/variant warnings, and confidence for the selected part.
Added in-app Patch Updates so product progress is visible on every release.
Specific parts begin using vendor-grounded references; generic entries are no longer treated as having exact ratings without an MPN/datasheet.

id: Pointer Events + requestAnimationFrame untuk drag yang lebih ringan.
Panel resize, pan/zoom, undo/redo, dan placement yang lebih fleksibel.
en: Pointer Events + requestAnimationFrame for smoother movement.
Resizable panels, pan/zoom, undo/redo, and more flexible placement.

id: Monte Carlo, tolerance, electro-thermal iteration, source/trace droop, dan fault injection.
Field envelope menjadi analisis lanjutan setelah live solver.
en: Monte Carlo, tolerance, electro-thermal iteration, source/trace droop, and fault injection.
Field envelope is now an advanced analysis after the live solver.

id: Fondasi awal asisten membaca project aktif dan menjalankan aksi dasar workspace.
en: Initial assistant foundation for reading the active project and basic workspace actions.
